meta.name: nile_river_town
meta.prompt: A New Kingdom Egyptian river town: mud-brick houses and workshops along the bank, a pylon temple with an avenue of sphinxes running down to the water, and reed boats drawn up on the Nile's mud.

programs.brief: A colossal New Kingdom Egyptian pylon temple complex built from sun-dried sandstone and mud-brick, featuring two massive battered pylon gate towers with flagstaff grooves flanking a tall central portal, opening into an inner peristyle courtyard.

tokens.terrain: a broad Nile riverbank with muddy shallows and reed beds beside the desert floodplain
tokens.infra: sphinx_avenue leading from the monumental pylon temple down to the Nile water's edge
tokens.icons: pylon temple with sphinx processional avenue; mud-brick workshops and courtyard houses along the bank; reed boats beached on the river mud; grain silos and nilometer by the water

root.label: A New Kingdom Egyptian river town along the Nile
